index.title: Jonas Girma
index.content:
I’m Jonas. a computer science student, lifelong learner, and maker of things.
This space is my digital garden:
A place where ideas grow over time, connected through links and enriched with my observations.
You’ll find:

Evergreen concepts I revisit and refine
Coding notes spanning Java, Python, web dev, systems & more
Project pages with explanations and examples
